summary: Added API/Worker/Web run scripts, environment examples, Prisma migration workflow and GitHub Actions quality gates for ATS-006.
command: npm run db:generate --prefix backend; npm run db:validate --prefix backend (dummy DATABASE_URL); npm run typecheck --prefix backend; npm run lint --prefix backend; npm run build; npm run build:api; git diff --check
scope: docs/ats-项目目标与实施路线图-v1.0.md

checks.name: startup_environment_and_migration_contract
criteria: API/Worker/Web 启动约定、无真实密钥的环境示例和可重复初始化/迁移文档可用。
checks.details: Root scripts expose separate Web, API and Worker startup commands; Worker runs as an application-context process and API does not consume the queue. backend/.env.example contains development placeholders. Two additive migrations are present, db:setup replays migrations and seeds roles/permissions, and existing-database baselining is documented.

checks.name: github_actions_quality_gates_configured
criteria: GitHub Actions 执行类型、Lint、单元/API 测试、各交付端构建、migration 校验和密钥检查；已有迁移不被覆盖。
checks.details: The workflow provisions ephemeral MySQL 8 and Redis 7, generates Prisma Client, validates schema, applies committed migrations, checks migration status, runs typecheck/Lint/unit/API commands, builds Web/API/Worker outputs, and scans repository history with Gitleaks. The workflow itself was not dispatched in this task. There is no browser-extension project to build yet.

checks.name: local_static_validation_and_build
checks.details: Prisma Client generation and schema validation passed; API/Worker typecheck and Nest build passed; oxlint exited successfully with one existing warning in audit CSV formatting; Web build passed; both backend/dist/main.js and backend/dist/worker.js exist.

limitations: Unit and API test suites were not run locally; CI is configured to run them on GitHub.
No migration was applied to the local MySQL database.
GitHub branch protection was not changed; it remains a repository-settings step requiring separate authorization.
The repository does not yet contain the browser extension project.
